171: 
172: Optional B roll, only if a retake needs it: hover the `Judge sheet` link to
173: show its status bar URL, or open `judge-sheet.html` and press browser Back
174: before the next clip. Do not add a clip that pushes the total over 120.000s.
175: 
176: ## Retake strategy
177: 
178: * Budget: one to two retakes per scene, six scenes, about 40 minutes of
179:   recording total. Record the hook first (it is the pitch), then the customer
180:   block, then the rest in shot order.
181: * After each clip: probe the duration, then check the three things that block
182:   needs (listed in the Frame must contain column). Fix immediately while the
183:   state is still fresh; never plan to repair a flub in the editor.
184: * Known flubs and their fixes:
185: 
186:   | Symptom | Cause | Fix |
187:   |---------|-------|-----|
188:   | Typing `4` lands in the lookup field | focus still in `#account-lookup` after Enter | click the `Take a shock` panel heading once, then press `4`, re record the block |
189:   | Guard chips not visible | chip row sits just below the fold | small scroll until both chips and the badge are in frame, re record block 2 |
190:   | Keys do nothing | focus on a button is fine, focus in an input is not | click the page header, then press the key |
191:   | Strip animation already finished when the frame lands | scroll was too slow | start the scroll earlier in the take, re record block 3 |
192:   | Narration overruns the block | reading too fast or adding words | read the line again at the printed pace, re record; never speed up in post |
193:   | Assembled total above 120.000s | clips ran long | re record `clip_06_close.mp4` shorter by the overshoot |
194:   | Audio level differs between clips | mic gain or distance changed | re record the quieter block; do not normalize one clip alone |
195: 
196: * Go or no go before the session: typecheck green, vitest green, build green,
197:   preview loads with Wi Fi off, `test_assemble.sh` prints ALL TESTS PASSED,
198:   one dry run of blocks 1 and 3 recorded and probed.
199: 
200: ## Never show on camera
201: 
202: * Any loading or error state: `Profiles failed to load`, `Counting the
203:   population...`, `forecast not wired yet`. Reload and re record instead.
204: * A failed or pending typed shock (`reading the sky`, a fallback note). The
205:   preset cards are the path.
206: * DevTools, the terminal, browser chrome other than the address bar, bookmarks,
207:   other tabs, notifications.
208: * Any sentence containing a dash character in an overlay you add.
209: * Any claim of synthetic data, any unmeasured number, any invented account id.
210: 
211: ## Production checklist
212: 
213: Audio
214: 
215: * [ ] Mic test recorded and played back at phone speaker volume before shot 1.
216: * [ ] Narration read verbatim from `docs/video/script.md`, about 256 words,
217:       digits read as printed, half second hold after each line.
218: * [ ] No keyboard clatter drowning the voice; if it does, re record with the
219:       laptop farther from the mic rather than muting the take.
220: * [ ] Voice over level near minus 16 LUFS in the edit; test once with sound off
221:       (the video must still read) and once at laptop speaker volume.
222: 
223: Pace
224: 
225: * [ ] Every headline held at least 2 seconds.
226: * [ ] Forecast strip animation completes before the scroll away.
227: * [ ] Six block durations recorded at 15, 20, 30, 20, 20, 15 seconds and the
228:       assembled total at most 120.000s, stated as 120.0s planned.
229: * [ ] Closing hold reaches 2:00.0 with no cursor movement.
230: 
231: Dashes and copy
232: 
233: * [ ] No em dash, en dash, minus sign, double hyphen, or spaced hyphen in any
234:       overlay, lower third, end card, or caption text (same patterns as
235:       `src/dashScan.test.ts`).
236: * [ ] Money cells that print a leading minus (`-$9.19`, `-$2,844.93`) are app
237:       output, allowed as formatted numbers, not prose.
238: * [ ] Spoken and printed numbers agree with the Number verification table in
239:       `docs/video/script.md`.
240: 
241: Honesty labels visible in the final cut
242: 
243: * [ ] `Recorded check sum ... This page shows the recorded value and does not
244:       recompute it.`
245: * [ ] `Simulated counterfactuals, applied one after another` plus both lever
246:       caveat sentences.
247: * [ ] `Context only: the projection starts from buffer B, the mean of the last 6
248:       recorded balances, not the last recorded balance.`
249: * [ ] `Beyond the answer key: EI income stops after month 6`
250: * [ ] `Anchored on Solana devnet, verified` plus the stamp note about bundled
251:       evidence files and no writes to chain.
252: * [ ] `At baseline: 1% (60 of 4,500)` in the closing frame.
253: * [ ] `preset cards` badge next to the typed row.
254: * [ ] Guard chip messages for 42988 in the sticky bar.
255: 
256: ## Upload and submission logistics
257: 
258: * Assemble, then re probe: duration at most 120.000s, codec h264, pix_fmt
259:   yuv420p (`assemble.sh` asserts all three).
260: * Upload to YouTube as **Unlisted**, audience Not for Kids. Private would hide
261:   it from judges.
262: * Title and description: paste the drafts in `docs/devpost.md` section 5
263:   (title `Storm Fund: your rainy day fund, as weather | Sheridan Datathon 2026`),
264:   then fill the bracketed links. The description's numbers (4,500 accounts,
265:   1.06M transactions, five verdict bands, integer cents, Gemini for typed input)
266:   must match what the video shows.
267: * Captions: export the SRT from the edit and upload it, since the local ffmpeg
268:   cannot burn subtitles.
269: * Thumbnail: the closing headline frame, 10% readable at 168x94.
270: * Logged out playback test in a private window at 1080p, sound off, then sound
271:   on, then links in the description clickable.
272: * Paste the YouTube link into the Devpost submission before the submission
273:   freeze at Sun Nov 8 11:00 AM (hard deadline 12:00 PM).
274: * Keep a local MP4 backup plus the six clips; `scripts/video/captures/` and
275:   `scripts/video/final/` are git ignored, so copy the final file somewhere safe
276:   before any cleanup.

## Documentation: 2 minute demo video script and screen recording plan

### Files Modified

| File | Action | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| `docs/video/script.md` | created | Timed narration plus on-screen action script for the 120 second demo, duration budget, assembly commands, number verification table, deviations |
| `docs/video/plan.md` | created | Setup (machine, browser, viewport, offline, bundle paths), recording approach, ordered shot list with exact clicks and keys, retake strategy, production checklist, upload logistics |

Nothing else was touched: no README, no `docs/devpost.md`, no staging, no commit (orchestrator commits).

### Content Summary

`script.md` mirrors the Meta Global reference (one read-aloud script, numbers spoken exactly as printed, verbatim lines) and adds the timed pairing the brief requires: each block is a table of `Time | On screen | Narration`, with `(line continues)` and `(line finishes here)` markers so the reading pace stays near 150 wpm. 256 spoken words over six blocks. `plan.md` mirrors the reference plan structure (purpose and audience, ranked format concepts, style guide, stand out strategy, production checklist, upload logistics) and adds the required setup, offline discipline, shot list, retake table, and honesty checklist.
